evidence.detail: Launcher constructs rs/gui/O and tags it with Substance property substancelaf.internal.titlePane.extraComponentKind = TRAILING before adding it directly to the title-pane component.
In the normal client path Launcher adds the 23x22 button whose exact tooltip is 'Hide/show side panel' and whose R280 SidePanelToggleAction sets the side-panel toggle request.

Launcher replaces the panel's constructor-installed legacy layout with GridBagLayout, adds it to the title pane, then installs LauncherTitleBarExtraControlsLayout to keep this panel aligned at the trailing edge.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the Launcher's Substance title-bar trailing extra-controls panel.

evidence.detail: Launcher obtains the Substance title-pane JComponent, saves its existing LayoutManager, then replaces it with rs/gui/A while passing the Launcher, original layout manager and title-pane component.
The class delegates add/remove/preferred/minimum/layout operations to the original LayoutManager before applying its own extra-control positioning.
After delegate layout, it reads the preferred width of Launcher field rs/gui/O and pins that panel at x = titlePaneWidth - 75 - panelWidth, y=0, height=titlePaneHeight.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the title-pane layout wrapper that positions the Launcher's trailing extra-controls panel.
